description: This Java source file contains a test suite class EntityUtilTestSuite that extends EntityTestCase, designed to test utility functions within the EntityUtil class of the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes setup methods, test cases for field list extraction, filtering entities based on conditions, and logical combinations of filters, using mock data generated within the class.

classes.name: EntityUtilTestSuite
classes.description: A JUnit test suite for validating utility functions in the EntityUtil class, including filtering, field extraction, and condition application on entity data.

methods.name: prepareGenericValueList
methods.description: Creates a list of mock GenericValue instances for testing, with IDs and description fields.

methods.name: testGetFieldListFromEntityList
methods.description: Tests extraction of field values from a list of entities, with options for distinctness.

methods.name: testFilterByCondition
methods.description: Tests filtering of entities based on specific conditions applied to their fields.

methods.name: testFilterByAnd
methods.description: Tests combining multiple conditions with AND logic for filtering entities.

methods.name: testFilterByOr
methods.description: Tests combining multiple conditions with OR logic for filtering entities.
